raw_market.question: 1Q Spread: Texas State (-7.5)
raw_market.description:
In the first quarter of the college football game between Colorado State and Texas State, scheduled for October 15 at 8:00 PM ET:

This market will resolve to "Texas State" if Texas State outscore Colorado State by 8 or more points in the first quarter.

Otherwise, this market will resolve to "Colorado State".

Only points scored during that period count; overtime is not included.

If the game is postponed, this market will remain open until the game has been completed. If the game is canceled entirely, with no make-up game, this market will resolve 50-50.
